attributes.name: ypy-sse:connect
attributes.description: Opens a Server-Sent Events stream with a GET request to the URL. The element connects on its `ypy-trigger` (default `load`). Each unnamed message is swapped into the target like a response; a message with an `event:` field is dispatched on the element as a DOM event with `detail.data` and `detail.id`. The connection reconnects with backoff and pauses while the tab is in the background. With `sse.heartbeat` a stream that goes silent is closed and opened again, and it is opened again at once when the page comes back (`pageshow`, `online`, a visible tab).

attributes.name: ypy-sse:close
attributes.description: Closes the stream when a message with this event name arrives. Without it the stream ends when the element is removed or the server closes it.

attributes.name: ypy-sse-connect
attributes.description: Legacy spelling of `ypy-sse:connect`. The extension copies it to the new name and warns in the console.

attributes.name: ypy-sse-close
attributes.description: Legacy spelling of `ypy-sse:close`. The extension copies it to the new name and warns in the console.

attributes.name: ypy-sse-swap
attributes.description: No longer supported. Unnamed SSE messages are swapped automatically and named events are dispatched as DOM events. The extension only warns in the console.
attributes.deprecated: Remove it: unnamed messages are swapped automatically, named events are DOM events.

events.name: ypy:sse:before:connection
events.description: Fires before a connection is made, and again before each reconnect attempt. Call `evt.preventDefault()` or set `detail.connection.cancelled = true` to stop connecting.

events.name: ypy:sse:after:connection
events.description: Fires when a response with `text/event-stream` was accepted, on the first connection and after each successful reconnect. `detail.connection.status` is the HTTP status.

events.name: ypy:sse:before:message
events.description: Fires for each parsed message before it is used. Cancel it, or set `detail.cancelled = true`, to ignore the message. Register asynchronous work with `detail.waitUntil(promise)`; YPY waits for it before deciding.

events.name: ypy:sse:after:message
events.description: Fires after a message was swapped, or after its named event was dispatched on the element.

events.name: ypy:sse:error
events.description: Fires when a connection attempt or the stream fails. `detail.status` is set when a reconnect got a non-2xx response. An aborted stream is a normal end and does not fire it.

events.name: ypy:sse:close
events.description: Fires once when the connection is cleaned up. `detail.reason` is `cancelled`, `message` (a `ypy-sse:close` event arrived), `ended`, `removed` or `cleanup`.

events.name: ypy:release
events.description: Named SSE event a server can send to release the request early (the queue slot and the indicators) while the stream stays open. It is dispatched on the element like any named event.

config.name: sse
config.description: Defaults of the ypy-sse extension. A single element overrides them with `ypy-config='{"sse":{...}}'`.

config.name: sse.reconnect
config.description: Reconnect after the stream ends or fails. The default is `true` for an element with `ypy-sse:connect` and `false` for a stream opened by a request.

config.name: sse.reconnectDelay
config.description: Wait before the first reconnect, in ms or as an interval string. The wait doubles on each attempt up to `reconnectMaxDelay`. A `retry:` field from the server replaces it.

config.name: sse.reconnectMaxDelay
config.description: Longest wait between two reconnect attempts, in ms or as an interval string.

config.name: sse.reconnectMaxAttempts
config.description: How many consecutive reconnect attempts are made before giving up. Unlimited by default.

config.name: sse.reconnectJitter
config.description: Random spread applied to each reconnect delay, as a fraction of the delay (0.3 is plus or minus 30%). `0` turns it off.

config.name: sse.connectTimeout
config.description: Timeout of a connection attempt, in ms or as an interval string. `0` waits without limit. Defaults to `ypy.config.defaultTimeout`.

config.name: sse.pauseOnBackground
config.description: Close the stream while the tab is hidden and reconnect when it is visible again. The default is `true` for an element with `ypy-sse:connect` and `false` otherwise.

config.name: sse.heartbeat
config.description: Close the stream and open it again when no byte arrives for this long, in ms or as an interval string such as `45s`. A comment line (`: ping`) counts as a byte, so a server that pings keeps the stream alive. It catches a connection that a sleeping phone left open: it neither fails nor ends, so the retry would never run. Off by default (`0`). It reconnects only when `sse.reconnect` is on; otherwise the silent stream ends. When the page is shown again (`pageshow` from the back/forward cache, `online`, a tab that is visible again) a stream silent for longer than this is opened again at once, and a wait for the next attempt is skipped.

config.name: sse.releaseOn
config.description: When the request gives back its queue slot and indicators: `immediate`, after the `first` swapped message, or at the `end` of the stream. The default is `immediate` for an element with `ypy-sse:connect` and `end` otherwise.
